name: Iran
description: Follow Iran, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Iranian leaders demand U.S. pay for war damage or will keep Strait of Hormuz closed
changes.summary: Iran's Revolutionary Guard insisted that the Strait of Hormuz will remain closed until the U.S. complies with a list of demands, including paying for war damage. Imtiaz Tyab reports on the latest in a series of mixed messages from the regime.

changes.title: Gas prices stubbornly stuck, up more than $1 since war with Iran started
changes.summary: The cost of the war with Iran on taxpayers continues to grow, not only to finance the Pentagon's plans, but at the pump. Taurean Small has more.

changes.title: Trump Says US is ‘Only Semi-Negotiating’ With Iran
changes.summary: Oil prices jumped higher after Iran issued a long list of demands to reopen the Strait of Hormuz. The United States announced more sanctions against Iran as questions loom over negotiations. NBC’s Keir Simmons reports for TODAY.

changes.title: Decades of abuse revealed at Michigan art school. And, the Iran war's impact on midterms
changes.summary: A new report has revealed decades of alleged abuse at an elite art school. NPR spoke with one of the victims. And, Iran is playing the long game with negotiations, which could impact midterms. (Image credit: Atta Kenare).

changes.title: How Cameras Can Track Every Car in the U.S., and Iran’s Catch-22
changes.summary: Plus, a drying river reveals Nazi-era vessels.

changes.title: Iran Taps Longtime I.R.G.C. Commander Mohsen Rezaei to Top Security Post
changes.summary: The appointment of Mohsen Rezaei, a longtime military commander, to a top security post suggests that the country’s establishment is consolidating power.

changes.title: Southern Iran Bears Brunt of U.S. Bombing
changes.summary: While fighting has abated in much of Iran, near-constant U.S. airstrikes in Qeshm island and other southern spots have upended lives and livelihoods.

changes.title: Iran Insists Strait of Hormuz Will Stay Closed Until Trump Agrees to Demands
changes.summary: A spokesman for the Iranian Foreign Ministry said that talks with Oman on shipping routes in the Strait of Hormuz were “separate” from discussions to fully reopen the waterway.

changes.title: Oil prices rise amid uncertainty over U.S.-Iran Strait of Hormuz deal
changes.summary: Oil was mixed as traders assess mixed signals from the U.S. and Iran amid worries that a deal to open the Strait of Hormuz may not be coming anytime soon.

changes.title: Trump is still searching for a way out of Iran
changes.summary: President Donald Trump is struggling to find a way out of the conflict with Iran, as voters lose patience with the war and weapons stockpiles dwindle. The path forward remains unclear, even as Trump has privately weighed dropping his long-held requirement for a nuclear deal. Washington is unlikely to accept Iran’s late.
